Ayurvedic doctors in Bangalore  treat conditions across joint and spinal health, skin diseases, hormonal disorders, digestive conditions, anorectal conditions, vascular problems, respiratory disease, neurological conditions, reproductive health, metabolic conditions, and autoimmune disease. You should consult one when modern medicine has not resolved a chronic condition, when surgery has been recommended for a non-emergency condition, or when you want to reduce long-term medication dependency.

Meet the Ayurvedic Doctors at Praanavaidya

Ayurvedic doctors in Bangalore at Praanavaidya are part of a clinically structured team that focuses on root-cause treatment of chronic diseases. Each doctor follows a standardized diagnostic and treatment protocol, ensuring consistent and high-quality care across all centers.

Core Ayurvedic Doctors in Bangalore(Leadership Team)

Dr. Chethan Upadhyaya – Medical Director

Dr. Chethan Upadhyaya leads the clinical direction at Praanavaidya and is responsible for designing treatment protocols followed across all centers. With extensive experience in Panchakarma and chronic disease management, he specializes in treating complex, multi-system conditions such as joint disorders, metabolic diseases, autoimmune conditions, and long-standing chronic illnesses.

His approach is rooted in precise diagnosis and root-cause correction, rather than symptom suppression. Patients under his care often present with multiple co-existing conditions, and his treatment strategies focus on addressing the underlying metabolic and inflammatory imbalance driving them.

Dr. Swasthika Upadhyaya – BAMS, MD (Ayu)

Dr. Swasthika Upadhyaya specializes in women’s health and hormonal disorders, including PCOD, PCOS, thyroid imbalance, infertility, and menstrual irregularities. She combines classical Ayurvedic detox therapies with long-term hormonal regulation strategies to restore natural balance.

Her clinical focus includes improving insulin resistance, cycle regularity, skin health, and reproductive outcomes through structured treatment plans. She also plays a key role in managing stress-related hormonal disruption by integrating therapies like Shirodhara and personalized lifestyle correction.

Dr. Pramod Karanth – BAMS, MD (Ayu), Center Head

Dr. Pramod Karanth oversees clinical operations and ensures consistent treatment delivery across Praanavaidya centers. He has strong expertise in digestive disorders, metabolic conditions, and Panchakarma therapies, including cases involving chronic acidity, IBS, fatty liver, and weight imbalance.

His treatment approach focuses on restoring Agni (digestive fire), eliminating Ama (toxins), and rebuilding metabolic stability. He is known for creating structured, easy-to-follow treatment plans that improve patient compliance and long-term outcomes.

  • Dr. Vyshnavi N Kini – Focus on chronic diseases, digestive and lifestyle disorders
  • Dr. Pallavi G Poojari – Specializes in hormonal health and women’s wellness
  • Dr. Kruttika Hegde – Expertise in joint pain and musculoskeletal conditions
  • Dr. Chinmayi B U – Focus on gut health, immunity, and general wellness
  • Dr. Pragathi Santhanam – Specializes in weight management and metabolic disorders

Ayurvedic Physicians

  • Dr. Raksha – Skin and hair disorders
  • Dr. Divya – General Ayurveda and preventive care
  • Dr. Adarsh R. Pal – Pain management and rehabilitation
  • Dr. Sharanbasappa – Chronic and inflammatory conditions

Conclusion

Choosing the right ayurvedic doctors in bangalore is essential when dealing with chronic or long-standing health conditions. The effectiveness of Ayurvedic treatment depends not just on therapies, but on the experience, diagnostic accuracy, and clinical approach of the doctor.w

At Praanavaidya, patients are treated by a team of qualified Ayurvedic physicians led by experienced senior doctors, ensuring every case is approached with clarity, structure, and a root-cause focus. From detailed diagnosis to personalized treatment plans and continuous monitoring, the care model is designed for long-term results, not temporary relief.

If you are looking for ayurvedic doctors in bangalore who combine classical Ayurveda with a modern clinical framework, Praanavaidya offers a reliable and comprehensive solution for managing chronic diseases and improving overall health.

Frequently Asked Questions

1. Who are the best ayurvedic doctors in Bangalore?

The best ayurvedic doctors in Bangalore are those who focus on root-cause diagnosis, provide personalized treatment, and have strong clinical experience in managing chronic diseases. At Praanavaidya, patients are treated by a team of qualified Ayurvedic physicians led by Dr. Chethan Upadhyaya, who is known for his expertise in Panchakarma and complex chronic disease management. The clinic follows a structured, physician-led approach that ensures consistent and effective outcomes.

2. When should I consult an ayurvedic doctor?

You should consult an ayurvedic doctor if:

  • Your condition is chronic and not improving
  • You want to avoid surgery (non-emergency cases)
  • You want to reduce long-term medication
  • You have multiple health issues

3. Do ayurvedic doctors treat chronic diseases?

Yes. Ayurvedic doctors specialize in managing chronic conditions such as arthritis, PCOD, thyroid disorders, digestive issues, and autoimmune diseases by addressing the root cause.

4. Is Panchakarma necessary for all patients?

No. Panchakarma is recommended only when clinically required. Treatment plans are personalized based on diagnosis.

5. Can Ayurveda help reduce long-term medication?

In many cases, when the underlying condition improves, medication dependency may reduce gradually under medical supervision.
